name: SHEIN

outcome.note: To the original payment method or SHEIN Wallet, as you choose. Original shipping fees are generally not refunded.

conditions.value: Most items within 30 days of delivery. Not returnable: bodysuits, lingerie and sleepwear, swimwear, jewelry and most accessories, and cosmetics with a broken seal.

processing.value: About 5–10 business days to a card, sometimes up to 30, depending on the bank

categories.label: Non-returnable items
examples: Most accessories (scarves, bags and mermaid blankets can be returned)

categories.label: Electronics
categories.conditions: New, unused, not activated, in the original packaging.

value.without: Returns are started from the order in your SHEIN account.

timing.value: About 5–10 business days to a card, sometimes up to 30, depending on the bank

fees.label: First return
fees.amount: Free for the first return from an order, subject to SHEIN's Fair Use Policy

fees.label: Later returns from the same order
fees.amount: $6.99 shipping fee, deducted from the refund

methods.label: Mail it back
steps: Open the order in your SHEIN account and request a return
Follow the return instructions SHEIN gives you

marketplace.value: Items from third-party sellers can have different return windows; check the order's return policy in your account.

unknowns.note: An older SHEIN page said 30 days from receipt or 45 days from purchase; the current page says 30 days from delivery.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
